prompt: Among companies listed on the NYSE or Nasdaq with revenue above $100 billion for a fiscal year ending between February 1, 2025 and January 31, 2026, what is the highest net margin (net income divided by revenue, from their 10-K filings)? Answer in percent, e.g. 12.34.

How many companies listed on the NYSE or Nasdaq reported capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment, or productive assets) above $20 billion for a fiscal year ending between February 1, 2025 and January 31, 2026, according to their 10-K filings? Answer with the count.
By what percentage did JPMorgan Chase's total assets grow from December 31, 2024 to December 31, 2025, according to its 10-K filings? Answer in percent, e.g. 4.56.
How many Form 8-K filings did Tesla, Inc. file during calendar year 2025 that report Item 5.02 (departure or appointment of directors or officers)? Answer with the count.
What was the average of the U.S. Treasury's daily 10-year par yield curve rate over the trading days of September 2026? Answer in percent to two decimals, e.g. 4.12.
By what percentage did Microsoft's diluted earnings per share grow from fiscal 2024 (ended June 30, 2024) to fiscal 2025 (ended June 30, 2025), as reported in its 10-K? Answer in percent, e.g. 15.5.

Using EDGAR full-text search, how many 10-K filing documents filed between January 1 and June 30, 2026 contain the exact phrase "reciprocal tariffs"? Answer with the count of documents EDGAR full-text search reports.

How many open-market or private sale transactions (transaction code S) did Apple insiders report on Form 4 filings filed between July 1 and September 30, 2026? Count each non-derivative transaction line with code S. Answer with the count.
